content.overview: BNS s. 161 — Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office.
content.study:
Introduction and meaning
Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office. BNS restatement of IPC 133. Elements are substantially the same; cite the BNS number for offences on or after 1 July 2024. BNS restatement of IPC 133. Cite the BNS number for facts on or after 1 July 2024.
In student language: BNS s. 161 is the rule on “Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office”. The section provides that whoever abets an assault by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, on any superior officer being in the execution of his office, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine. Do not stop at the heading. An examiner awards marks for the ingredients, the explanations and the illustrations, not for writing the title alone.

Why this is asked
Criminal law arguments turn on statutory ingredients. BNS s. 161 exists so that “Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office” has a closed legal test in Chapter VIII — Of Offences Relating to the Army, Navy and Air Force. An authoritative analysis defines the concept, lists every ingredient, walks the statutory illustrations, states exceptions, and applies the test methodically to facts.
Chapter setting: Mutiny, desertion, insubordination, and wearing a service garb.

The provision in detail
161. Whoever abets an assault by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, on any superior officer being in the execution of his office, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine
